Population increased in Telford and Wrekin

The estimated population of Telford and Wrekin in 2024 was 195,952 usual residents, a rise of 1.8% since 2023.

This meant that Telford and Wrekin's rate of population change placed it among the 20 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Telford and Wrekin increased by 5.4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Telford and Wrekin was also among the 20% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Telford and Wrekin

The average (median) age stayed at 39.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Telford and Wrekin has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Telford and Wrekin is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Telford and Wrekin's population of 195,952 usual residents was made up of:

  • 39,173 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20%)
  • 121,785 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.2%)
  • 34,994 people aged 65 years and over, (17.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Telford and Wrekin has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (20% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Telford and Wrekin, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Telford and Wrekin
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Telford and Wrekin, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 249 people (0.1%). In total, there were 1,929 births and 1,680 deaths in Telford and Wrekin.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,754 (0.9%). There were 9,933 people entering the area and 8,179 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Telford and Wrekin's population of 1,552 (0.8%) as a result of 2,332 people entering the area and 780 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Telford and Wrekin was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Telford and Wrekin in mid-2023 is 192,417.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 291 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 211 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 502 people.
